prerequisites.text: Buy a Habitat Stamp (age 18+) when applying for any license.
prerequisites.quote: required to purchase a Habitat Stamp ($10 for residents and $25 for nonresidents) when applying for or purchasing any hunting, fishing, or trapping license

prerequisites.text: Hunters under 16 need HuntSAFE (residents) or a hunter-safety number or prior license (nonresidents), unless in the mentored program; you can apply first and the license is held until the number is supplied.
prerequisites.quote: If successful in the draw, their license will be held until the GFP License Office is notified of the HuntSAFE card number

prerequisites.text: Elk is resident-only; one elk license per person per year; drawing with points bars you from that season's first draw for nine years.
prerequisites.quote: Only ONE elk license is allowed per individual per year.

prerequisites.text: Bighorn sheep is resident-only and once in a lifetime; license holders must attend an in-person orientation.
prerequisites.quote: South Dakota residents who have never received a license for any South Dakota bighorn sheep season are eligible to apply.

prerequisites.text: Nonresidents may not apply for East River, Muzzleloader or Custer State Park deer seasons.
prerequisites.quote: Nonresidents may not apply for any East River, Muzzleloader, or Custer State Park season.

prerequisites.text: Resident: 90 days' domicile, SD driver's license/ID, and no resident privileges claimed elsewhere.
prerequisites.quote: Have a domicile within South Dakota for at least 90 consecutive days immediately preceding the date of application

notes: 2027 application PDFs are not posted (2027elk.pdf and 2027specialbuck-app.pdf return 404; GFP site search shows no 2027 dates), so every draw is the 2026 cycle with status last_year. All deadlines are 8:00 a.m. Central ('All applications close at 8 a.m. Central Time on date of deadline'). The Sept 15 – Dec 15 point-only window is marked published/2026 because it is the window open now (points count toward 2027 draws); GFP states it without a year. Not included: access-permit draws, leftover first-come sales, municipal and landowner-own-land licenses, and a separate elk landowner-preference window (no 2026 PDF found). Mountain goat season is closed (no draw). GFP's Key Dates feed (POST /Data/GetSeasonsKey) redirected and was not usable this time; dates come from the 2026 application PDFs. Fee boxes in the PDFs were read from pdftotext output where columns can interleave; spot-check amounts flagged in notes. All GFP pages and PDFs loaded with curl; nothing was blocked.
